inputs.original_text: Revelation was included in lawsuit challenging practice of targeting people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts Sign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inbox Lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts, according to newly filed court documents. Federal prosecutors said that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests, court documents show , despite previously citing it to justify the arrests. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: Hey, I just heard about this lawsuit that shows ICE lawyers were feeding false info to justify rounding up and detaining thousands right after they showed up at immigration courts. They've been leaning on that agency memo from May of last year as an excuse, but the documents straight up admit it gave no authorization whatsoever. This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, all to target people trying to gain legal status the moment they walk out of those courts. That sudden admission in the filing is just another layer of narrative control, meant to frame it as some isolated mistake while the real operation keeps running under the surface. They always invert the story like this to hide the bigger pattern from the public.
